hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Spillover Momentum
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information diffuses gradually across complex inter-firm production networks. pv13_custretsig_retsig measures the directional return signal propagated from major commercial customers to suppliers (Matrix, 93% coverage in US equities). When customers experience positive operating and stock market shocks, supplier earnings and equity prices reflect these benefits with a multi-day delay due to institutional inattention. Applying a 5-day linear decay captures this customer-driven momentum while dampening noise.
confounders: Supplier customer-concentration risk where a single customer termination disrupts organic network spillover
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if customer spillover signal yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of customer return spillover signal.

hypotheses.title: Options Implied Volatility Term Structure Contango Slope
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In normal equity market equilibrium, the options volatility term structure trades in contango (implied_volatility_mean_90 > implied_volatility_mean_30, 98% coverage in TOP3000). When near-term uncertainty or idiosyncratic liquidity stress hits an individual stock, short-term implied volatility spikes, flattening or inverting the term structure into backwardation. Selecting equities with the steepest upward-sloping volatility term structure concentrates capital in calm, unhedged names with resilient risk premia and zero near-term catalyst distress.
confounders: Macro-wide market flash crashes that invert volatility term structures across all single stocks simultaneously
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volatility term slope yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 10-day decay of implied volatility term structure spread (90-day IV minus 30-day IV).

hypotheses.title: Downside Put Breakeven Support Floor Distance
hypotheses.economic_rationale: put_breakeven_30 measures the open-interest weighted price at which 30-day put option buyers break even at maturity (Matrix, 98% coverage in TOP3000). Equities trading comfortably above their aggregate put breakeven levels ((close - put_breakeven_30) / close > 0) sit within a structural positive gamma zone for options market makers. In this regime, dealer hedging dampens downside volatility and provides institutional support, creating persistent forward positive returns.
confounders: Severe gap-down earnings reports that instantly breach put breakeven strikes and flip market makers into short gamma
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if put breakeven distance yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 10-day decay of spot distance above the 30-day put breakeven price.
